For a NON-PARTISAN civic information site, omitting that a single-family residence is proposed in an Open Space zone creates misleading understatement of the proposal's potential controversy and significance. A reasonable resident interested in land-use politics would perceive the headline as minimizing or obscuring contested zoning facts.
